name: Tsukinoki Kotoha
source:
The student council president with a dignified sense of responsibility.

A young lady who has grown into an admirable council president.
Her growth since the previous work is evident, moving Shuuichi who witnesses it.
While she remains serious and rigid as ever, she consciously carries herself with grace,
having evolved into a hard worker who strives to be worthy of her title.
Yet, as always, she still goes off the rails at times.
